R01.scope: Published dual-boot detector; not a validated MPU6050 or single-boot implementation.

R02.scope: Primary MPU6050 driver corroborates supported ranges and a nominal 20 Hz filter option. Upstream master may change; inspect actual device/library.

R03.scope: OpenSki engineering requirements and capability limits; no empirical acceptance thresholds.

R04.scope: Original manual pixel annotations in selected public frames; uncalibrated image proxies only.

parameters.applicable_to: MPU6050 initial acquisition/logging experiment; separately validate each replacement IMU.
parameters.rationale: 10 ms nominal sample spacing provides substantially more samples than a turn-scale event needs while keeping raw logging manageable. This is our design choice, not a value inferred from public videos.
parameters.validation: Measure actual device intervals, jitter, FIFO overflow and sample loss; compare 100 and 200 Hz recordings before selecting a production rate.
limitations: Sampling does not guarantee 10 ms event accuracy.
BLE packet rate is independent of sensor acquisition rate.

parameters.applicable_to: MPU6050; symmetric full scale of -1000 to +1000 deg/s.
parameters.rationale: Use an available wider range for initial recordings to reduce clipping risk; not a prediction of skier peak rates.
parameters.validation: Verify read-back, scale and known bench rotations; inspect per-axis clipping. Compare lower ranges only after observing real noise and headroom.
limitations: Wider range trades quantisation resolution for headroom.
Export angular rates in rad/s; pi/180 converts deg/s.

parameters.applicable_to: MPU6050; symmetric full scale of -16 to +16 g.
parameters.rationale: Initial impact/headroom-oriented logging choice among supported ranges; not expected sustained skiing acceleration.
parameters.validation: Check static gravity, multi-orientation scale and clipping; reassess range after real recordings.
limitations: Acceleration includes gravity unless explicitly processed otherwise.
Export SI acceleration using a documented g conversion; does not measure ski pressure.

parameters.applicable_to: Requested MPU6050 gyroscope bandwidth; confirm actual driver mapping, coupled accelerometer behaviour and sampling configuration.
parameters.rationale: Keep bandwidth above the turn-analysis filters while suppressing some high-frequency content before 100 Hz logging. The primary driver includes this nominal option.
parameters.validation: Confirm register/library semantics, bandwidth, delay and end-to-end aliasing with bench excitation and higher-rate comparison recordings.
limitations: This does not guarantee adequate anti-alias rejection.
Exact filter delay and register values have not been verified for the user's module; no register writes supplied.

parameters.applicable_to: Proposed transport batching budget, subject to negotiated MTU and existing firmware.
parameters.rationale: Allows roughly five samples at 100 Hz per batch without replacing individual acquisition timestamps.
parameters.validation: Measure sustained throughput, queue growth, packet loss and phone reconnection behaviour; reduce batch size to fit payload limits.
limitations: Not a BLE connection-interval prescription.
Transport latency is not sensor event time.

parameters.applicable_to: Initial stationary bias/noise capture before a session.
parameters.rationale: Collects approximately 1000 samples at the proposed rate for an initial bias and noise inspection.
parameters.validation: Verify actual stillness, temperature stability and repeated calibration consistency. A duration alone cannot qualify calibration.
limitations: Stillness acceptance thresholds remain unset pending bench data.
A stationary bias check does not calibrate sensor-to-boot alignment or dynamic orientation.

parameters.applicable_to: Diagnostic flag when adjacent acquisition timestamps differ by more than this value at nominal 100 Hz.
parameters.rationale: Two nominal sample periods is a simple initial diagnostic, not a validated accuracy threshold.
parameters.validation: Always inspect sequence gaps as well; evaluate actual clock jitter and whether missing samples affect each metric.
limitations: A smaller gap may still lose a sample; do not rely on this flag alone.
Do not silently interpolate across gaps or saturation.

parameters.applicable_to: Engineering target for residual relative clock error, not achieved accuracy or a bilateral-symmetry tolerance.
parameters.rationale: Start with a clock-error budget on the order of one proposed sample interval; refine using the lag resolution the experiment actually needs.
parameters.validation: Measure offset, drift and residuals across the run against a common event/reference. Lag interpretation also needs event-detection uncertainty.
limitations: No zero-lag ideal is implied.
Withhold lag conclusions whenever uncertainty is comparable to the observed lag.

parameters.applicable_to: Offline replication of R01: bilateral roll-rate combination, fourth-order Butterworth, zero-lag processing, correct sign/axis mapping.
parameters.rationale: Published coarse-decision filter; not an OpenSki-validated cutoff.
parameters.validation: Replicate the complete method before evaluating new hardware, tasks and single-boot variants.
limitations: Zero-phase offline processing uses future samples and cannot be copied directly into causal real-time feedback.
Strong smoothing can attenuate short turns.

parameters.applicable_to: R01 refinement of already accepted coarse events; not an independent complete detector.
parameters.rationale: Published fine-timing branch uses a higher cutoff than its coarse decision branch.
parameters.validation: Check filtering conventions, boundary transients and annotation agreement in offline replication.
limitations: Does not make every local extremum a turn switch.
Causal filtering introduces timing/latency differences that require separate validation.

parameters.applicable_to: R01 search neighbourhood: 0.6 of the interval to each neighbouring coarse extremum, separately before and after the candidate.
parameters.rationale: Published refinement setting; not a target turn-phase fraction.
parameters.validation: Confirm event pairing and edge cases under exact replication before tuning.
limitations: Requires valid neighbouring candidates.
Not a symmetric fixed-second window.

parameters.applicable_to: R01 coarse candidate rule for opposite-sign extrema: strictly greater than 0.3 and strictly less than 5 seconds, with the other published rules.
parameters.rationale: Replicated search gate; not an ideal turn-duration range or definition of short/long turns.
parameters.validation: Audit excluded events and false/missed turns by task; flag out-of-domain events instead of scoring them poorly.
limitations: Can exclude valid slow traverses or very rapid movements.
The full detector includes amplitude/decision rules not completed in this profile.

parameters.rationale: Public visual observations provide no measured boot-rate amplitude or device noise floor.
parameters.validation: Appraise the complete published thresholds and fit/validate on separate raw recordings without participant leakage.
limitations: No arbitrary fixed threshold supplied; detector remains incomplete.

parameters.applicable_to: Six-axis orientation estimation, if later introduced.
parameters.rationale: Algorithm, sensor noise and sustained-turn acceleration behaviour have not been established.
parameters.validation: Select a specific fusion algorithm and validate dynamic orientation against an independent reference.
limitations: Accelerometer gravity correction is unreliable during sustained acceleration.

parameters.applicable_to: Knee, anatomical ankle, hip angulation, torso lean or true snow-relative ski edge angle targets.
parameters.rationale: Manual projected estimates are frame-specific and uncertain; they do not establish ideals or boot-sensor observability.
parameters.validation: Calibrated movement references, contextual multi-skier distributions and independent outcome evidence.
limitations: Never import manual image angles into boot-orientation thresholds.

parameters.rationale: No measured force data or validated target distribution is available.
parameters.validation: Calibrate insoles and account for boot-cuff force paths; relate plantar loading to independent outcomes.
limitations: Neither a boot IMU nor visible outside-leg extension measures load ratio.

parameters.rationale: A measurable lag need not be a technique fault and may be task-dependent.
parameters.validation: Separate clock/event uncertainty from repeatable task-specific relationships with skiing outcomes.
limitations: No universal simultaneous-edging requirement or zero-lag ideal.

unknowns: True ski edge and anatomical joint angles
Physical durations and phase fractions in the reviewed public clips
manufacturer_document_check: Official legacy register-map requests redirected to HTML or failed. Supported options were cross-checked against the primary Linux MPU6050 driver; actual module/library registers, delays and coupled filters still need bench confirmation.
